discount.description: 13% discount applies to base charges only

overage.text: Overage rate: $0.10 per unit above monthly limit of 1,000 units. Overage charges are calculated at the end of each billing cycle.

base_limit.text: Base usage limit: 1,000 units per month. Units are measured as individual API calls aggregated across all endpoints.

discount_scope.text: Discounts apply to base charges only, not overage or add-on charges. Any discount applied beyond base charges is a billing error and subject to correction.

termination.text: Either party may terminate with 4 days written notice.

payment.text: Payment due within 30 days of invoice date.

governing_law.text: This Agreement is to be construed according to the laws          of the State of Illinois.

legal_terms.renewal_term: If Distributor                            complies with all of the terms of this Agreement, the                            Agreement  shall be  renewable on an annual basis for                            one (1) year terms for up to  another  ten (10) years                            on the same terms and conditions as set forth herein.
legal_terms.governing_law: This Agreement is to be construed according to the laws          of the State of Illinois.
legal_terms.termination_notice: Upon the expiration or termination of                   this  Agreement,  pursuant to Section  4.1 or 4.2 hereof,  the                   Company may, at its option to be  exercised  within 30 days of                   the date of the termination of this Agreement, and in its sole                   discretion,  repurchase  any Products in the possession of the                   Distributor  at the net invoice price paid by the  Distributor                   to  the  Company  less  any  applicable  special   allowances,                   discounts, shipping or allowances for cooperative advertising.
